title: Waterfalls — silky vs. frozen
summary: Silky ribbon or frozen chaos — two different shutter worlds, decide before you set up.
why: Water at ½s blurs into silk; at 1/1000s every droplet hangs sharp. Mid-range shutters give you neither — the mush zone. Iceland's daylight is too bright for ½s without help, hence the ND on the 52mm thread.

steps.text: Tripod down, compose, focus, then switch the lens to M so AF can't hunt
Thread the ND on, set mode dial to M
Dial 1/2s · f/16 · ISO 100, check the histogram, adjust shutter
Fire with the 2s self-timer — hands off the body

pitfalls: Seljalandsfoss spray hits the front element in seconds — compose, wipe, shoot, repeat. Microfiber in an outside pocket.
No ND? Frozen version instead: S mode, 1/1000s, and let ISO climb.
levelUp: Bracket shutter, not exposure: ¼s, ½s, 1s render the same fall three different ways — pick the texture later.
